newsitem.title: CANADA: St. Lawrence Seaway sets January 1 close date.
newsitem.headline: St. Lawrence Seaway sets January 1 close date.

text.p: Vessels navigating the St. Lawrence Seaway must be in certain positions by December 20 for the system to close by January 1, a St. Lawrence Seaway Authority spokeswoman said.

"The vessels must be at ports of call by December 20 so we expect to close by January 1 when the last ship clears. I think we're likely to keep to that schedule because there's no ice in the system and ships can transit easily," St. Lawrence Seaway Authority spokeswoman Sylvie Moncion said in French.
The federal agency operates Canada's 13 locks and four canals from Lake Erie to Montreal.
Last winter, the Seaway closed on Dec 28, 1995, and reopened March 29, 1996.
